listing.name: Alisia Dragoon — AlisiaDragoonRecomp (ohackercego)
listing.summary: The project reports no 68000 ROM fallbacks and eight Z80 reset-window fallbacks. This does not establish full-game progression. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA ROM, 1048576 bytes, with SHA-256 cb4e9c98de5a048ccdddf03bcfa5d8aad678c2399f4c5651075009c59836ffd2.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s release instructions and select your own ROM in the player. Building from source generates 68000 and Z80 C code locally, then builds with VS2022 and CMake. No Linux or macOS packages are offered.

warnings: The project reports no 68000 ROM fallbacks and eight Z80 reset-window fallbacks. This does not establish full-game progression.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
